title: “Combatting antisemitism TOGETHER” SCA Hanukkah message by Mrs. Doris Cohen

chapters.title: The True Beginning of the Hanukkah War
Rabbi Sachs on Antisemitism and Internal Strength
chapters.about: Rabbi Sachs, antisemitism, tolerance among Jews

chapters.title: The Real Message of Hanukkah
chapters.about: unity, Torah, Berit, shining a light together

summary: Mrs. Cohen discusses the real message of Hanukkah by exploring the historical complexity of the conflict, noting that it began as a civil conflict between Jews before becoming a war against the Greeks. She shares a teaching from Rabbi Sachs about antisemitism and suggests that strengthening internal unity, Torah values, and tolerance among different factions of Jews is our greatest weapon against outside enemies.
questions: Was the story of Hanukkah strictly a war between the Greeks and the Jews?
How did the war of Hanukkah actually begin?
What did Rabbi Sachs say about antisemitism?
How can we combat antisemitism according to the class?
Why is tolerance among different Jewish factions important during Hanukkah?
